data.gender_notes: Rafiqah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the masculine name Rafiq, Rafiqah means 'friend' or 'companion'. The name Rafiqah carries the meaning “Friend, Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Rafiqah usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A true friend and companion, Rafiqah embodies loyalty and support.
data.etymology: Rafiqah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rafiqah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: رفيقه
in_arabic.long_meaning: رفيقه، من الفعل رفض، بمعنى السّمع والاتّصال. تعني رفيقة الطريق، والصديقة الموثوقة، والمرسلة التي تنقل الرسائل. تُستخدم في القرآن الكريم لوصف الأصدقاء المقربين من الله تعالى.

in_urdu.name: رفیقہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: رفیقہ، یہ لفظ عربی زبان کے فعل 'رَفِق' سے اخذ کیا گیا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'ساتھ رکھنا'۔ اس کا مطلب 'صديقہ'، 'ساتھی'، 'رفقہ'، 'حواریہ' اور 'رسول' بھی ہو سکتا ہے۔ اسے اکثر عورتوں کے نام کے طور پر استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو ایماندار، وفادار اور نیک دل ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रफीक़ा
in_hindi.long_meaning: रफ़ीक़ा, यह नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'रफ़ीक' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ 'साथी' या 'दोस्त' होता है। यह नाम एक ऐसी महिला के लिए उपयुक्त है जो ईमानदार, विश्वसनीय और दयालु होती है। इस नाम का इस्तेमाल अक्सर धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक संदर्भों में पाया जाता है।

in_english.long_meaning: Rafiqah is an Arabic name derived from the root 'r-f-q', meaning 'to accompany' or 'to befriend'. It signifies a close friend, companion, confidante, and someone who is trustworthy and reliable. In Islamic tradition, Rafiqah often refers to a pious and righteous woman who stands by her faith and values.
